## Appearance

The Rev. [James](../character/james-a.md) Perry is a sleek, rubicund man featuring a shining bald head. He has bushy white eyebrows along with a bristling white moustache.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007)_

## Personality

Perry is an unhandsome individual who displays a tiresome and pompous demeanor.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007)_

## History

Perry was a [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) boy who attended school with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), where he earned a reputation as a detestable prig. Later, while serving as a visiting minister, he attended a dinner that included a pet rooster killed in his honor. During a subsequent conversation in the study, his condescending lecture enraged [Faith](../character/faith.md), who deliberately allowed his coat-tails to catch fire from the hearth, leaving him furious and his garment scorched.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P0](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P14](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P15](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P20](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0020)_
